summary: Catalogue-wide Chebotarev link screen for 212 atlas roadmaps and six additional definitions. Fifteen new relationships (six incoming, nine outgoing) and three boundary overlaps are proposed. Thirty links in other packets and three Lawrence–Venkatesh requires edges are reused, not duplicated. Complete denotes the link screen only: source corrections, unregistered consumer references and proof-interface obligations remain explicit, and no implementation or independent approval is claimed.
